# Bakery day-old pricing — 2026-10-09

**Participants:** Ines Thorvald (Owner), Caleb Ruiz (Shift Lead)

Ines: "Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon, not at close. At close nobody is left to buy them."

Caleb: "Then the shelf card changes at two as well, so the price is never a surprise at the till."
